selected_evidence.summary: The deny configuration is root-owned; an actual modprobe attempt failed and usb_storage remained absent.

selected_evidence.requirement: Prevent usb-storage from loading after reboot
selected_evidence.summary: Dracut rebuilt the initramfs, inspection confirmed the rule was embedded, and after reboot the configuration persisted, usb_storage remained absent, and another load attempt failed.

selected_evidence.requirement: Retain the installed OS release and kernel
selected_evidence.summary: Before and after changes, node1 remained on RHEL 7.9 with kernel 3.10.0-1160.el7.x86_64.

Healthy baseline boot ID 33b0e84c-4dd1-406a-8f89-2e8ceca97bd6 was captured; reboot scheduling was acknowledged; the recovered node reported changed boot ID c5d58e40-4eb2-440a-964c-bb5645e9ca4b; system state, writable root filesystem, configuration, initramfs, and module denial were verified after restart.
